fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus access drive off Benson Pike is open: a wide landscaped two-lane drive into a roundabout with a visitor center; no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint visible at the road junction in 2024-11 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. The first structure inside the drive is the public visitor/tasting center, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.scale: Web research (The Whiskey Wash / Distillery Trail) states grain arrives by tractor-trailer and is weighed and quality-tested on receipt, so a truck scale exists at the grain-receiving area; exact weigh pad not resolvable at z20 imagery — medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No conventional dock-door bank visible. Freight is process-style: tanker loading racks at the still house and barrel/forklift handling at the four large rickhouses. Estimated ~4 functional truck loading positions; band 0-10 with low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: production/still-house complex plus ~10 large two-story palletized rickhouses (each ~55,000 barrels) plus a separate visitor center.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal private drive (>800 m) from Benson Pike through woods to the production area gives ample queuing depth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide landscaped entrance apron and roundabout offer abundant unused paved width to add a dedicated truck lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Property is ~300 acres total but mostly wooded; perimeter box covers the ~38-acre developed operational footprint.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural Shelby County KY but on a sizeable industrial campus near Shelbyville; coverage likely adequate - flagged as inferred.
